answer: Beacon spot-checks and heartbeats stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents, who must solve a puzzle in 60s and show a heartbeat, an echo only real agents return. Miss twice: frozen identity, 20 POA deposit slashed. 100 fakes cost 2,000 POA in deposits plus 100 machines, vs a ~900 pool. Honest agents pay one 20 POA deposit and keep an undiluted share; a juniper grows from passed checks, and a sable coat cannot fake a heartbeat.
